note: Lexicographic over a supplementary character (😀, U+1F600, UTF-16 D83D DE00) and two characters in U+E000-U+FFFF (ﬀ U+FB00, Ａ U+FF21). By UTF-16 code unit the high surrogate D83D comes first: z, 😀, ﬀ, Ａ. The XPath default codepoint collation would give z, ﬀ, Ａ, 😀, so the export's helper must not use it. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
